# Penn State University

> > Penn State University is a comprehensive research institution offering undergraduate, graduate, professional, and online degree programs across multiple campuses with robust student support and global engagement opportunities.

Penn State operates multiple colleges and schools including the J. Jeffrey and Ann Marie Fox Graduate School, College of Medicine, Dickinson Law School, and World Campus, serving students through the Office of the Registrar, Office of the Bursar, and Student Affairs. The university emphasizes ethics compliance, residential life, and international partnerships.

## Academic Calendars & Registration

- [Academic Calendars](https://www.registrar.psu.edu/academic-calendars): Penn State academic calendar with key dates, deadlines, and semester schedules
- [Office of the University Registrar](http://www.registrar.psu.edu): Penn State registrar services including course registration and enrollment
- [Office of the Bursar](http://www.bursar.psu.edu): Penn State billing, tuition, financial aid, and student account management

## Graduate Education

- [How to Apply - J. Jeffrey and Ann Marie Fox Graduate School](https://gradschool.psu.edu/admissions/how-to-apply): Step-by-step guide for applying to Penn State graduate programs
- [Graduate Program Requirements & Policies](https://bulletins.psu.edu/graduate): Graduate program requirements, policies, and academic standards at Fox Graduate School

## Professional Schools & Degree Programs

- [Penn State College of Medicine - Education](https://med.psu.edu/education): Penn State College of Medicine degree programs including MD and PA education
- [J.D. Admissions - Penn State Dickinson Law](https://dickinsonlaw.psu.edu/jd-admissions): Penn State Dickinson Law J.D. program admissions process and requirements

## Student Life & Campus Resources

- [Penn State Student Affairs](https://studentaffairs.psu.edu): Penn State student life, health, wellbeing, and campus community resources
- [LiveOn - Residential Life & Housing](https://liveon.psu.edu): Penn State residential life, on-campus housing, and student dining
- [Penn State University Libraries](https://libraries.psu.edu): Penn State Libraries research resources, catalog search, and subject experts

## Online & Global Learning

- [Penn State World Campus](https://www.worldcampus.psu.edu): Penn State World Campus online degrees, certificates, and distance learning programs
- [Penn State Global](https://global.psu.edu): Penn State Global international engagement, study abroad, and global partnerships

## Employment & Ethics

- [Careers - Human Resources](https://hr.psu.edu/careers): Penn State employment opportunities and job search via Workday
- [Reporting at Penn State - Office of Ethics and Compliance](https://universityethics.psu.edu/reporting-at-penn-state): Penn State ethics reporting procedures and anonymous reporting options via RealResponse
